name: 07502 · Paterson, NJ
findings: ZIP 07502 (Paterson) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07502 (Paterson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07502 (Paterson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 26% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
